about: Supplied documents the compiler adds, once, to a version whose base lacks them, from `effective` on (backend_pipeline/knowledge/additions.py). Each entry is reviewed as a whole: its file is committed beside the knowledge base and bound by `sha256` (the hash of its text with line endings normalised and outer whitespace stripped, as the loader reads it), so the runtime never reads the source it was derived from (R52) and a changed file stops the compile until it is reviewed again. A new document is an identity change: the version waits for its benchmark (R44).
